landing_tab_title: Access Sphere - Identity, OAuth2 & Security Management Platform
landing_hero_title: Identity, OAuth2 Clients and Enterprise Security in One Sphere.
landing_hero_desc: Access Sphere is the high-performance reactive authorization server powered by Spring Boot WebFlux. Centralize authentication, user & role management (RBAC), OAuth2 client registration with redirect URIs, JWE encryption, and multi-factor authentication (MFA).
landing_scroll_hint: Scroll to discover the ecosystem: the 3D Sphere transforms and adapts
landing_about_title: What is Access Sphere and what can you do?
landing_about_desc: Access Sphere is not just a login page: it is a comprehensive Identity and Access Management (IAM) ecosystem designed to centralize the security of modern architectures.
landing_feat1_desc: Register, modify, and delete third-party applications and microservices on the fly. Configure client_id, client_secret, allowed redirect URIs, token format (JWT or JWE), and dedicated cryptographic lifetimes for every DB-registered app.
landing_feat2_desc: Full control over user lifecycle: instant lock/unlock of suspicious accounts, guided registration, profile updates, and granular RBAC profiling with tailored permissions.
landing_feat3_desc: Strengthen security with multi-factor authentication: native support for TOTP on apps like Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator, and OTP single-use codes via secure email.
landing_feat4_desc: Issue tokens with digital signature (JWS) or end-to-end encryption (JWE) to shield sensitive claims on untrusted networks. Configure dedicated signing keys and custom lifetimes for access and refresh tokens.
landing_feat5_desc: Automatically synchronize your external systems: dispatch asynchronous HTTP webhook events on login, user registration, role update, token revocation, or client key rotation.
landing_feat6_desc: Engineered on Project Reactor non-blocking asynchronous architecture. Handles massive concurrent authentication spikes without thread starvation under 20ms latency.
landing_feat7_desc: Customize the application 100%: choose between 6 dynamic Material 3 color palettes, set enterprise white-label branding (name, logo, favicon, tagline), configure login screen with showcase or custom dimmed background, select automatic or manual language, and export/restore the entire database in JSON snapshot format with one click.
landing_sim_title: Test live Token generation and OAuth2 Flows
landing_sim_desc: Click the buttons to simulate runtime authentication requests. Observe how Access Sphere encapsulates claims, application roles, and encrypted session keys:
landing_sim_default_action: Click one of the buttons to simulate token issuance!
landing_arch_title: Transparent Architecture: Everything in DB has a Dedicated UI
landing_arch_point1_desc: Every database parameter (id, clientId, redirect_uri, scopes, jwtExpiration, webhooks) is manageable directly from the GUI with full CRUD support.
landing_arch_point2_desc: Instant user moderation with automatic fallback support between Strapi CMS and local relational Database.
landing_arch_point3_desc: Protection against brute-force attacks on password and token endpoints with Bucket4j filter at the gateway layer.
landing_quick_users_desc: View user directory, block accounts, manage RBAC roles.
landing_quick_clients_desc: Create, edit, and delete OAuth2 clients and redirect URIs.
landing_quick_login_desc: Sign in with your credentials or request secure access.
landing_quick_github_desc: Explore source code, documentation, and contributions.
